name: Hyde Park Saturday Hunt
location: Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, London

checkpoints.name: Stone fountain
checkpoints.clue: Where a princess is remembered by water that never runs in a straight line.

challenge.scene: The Diana Memorial Fountain: a wide oval ring of pale granite with shallow water running through it, set in open lawn with trees behind.
challenge.pose: Side profile, looking to your left, with the landmark behind you.

checkpoints.name: Boy who never grew up
checkpoints.clue: He promised never to grow old; find him by the long water.

challenge.scene: The bronze Peter Pan statue on a tall plinth covered in climbing fairies, rabbits and mice, with the Long Water and trees behind.
challenge.pose: Arms raised as if flying, facing the camera, with the landmark behind you.

checkpoints.name: Speakers' Corner
checkpoints.clue: Stand on a soapbox where anyone may have their say. Open for the last hour only.
